## Table S20 -Cond_State Pathways
| Supplementary Table 20 Condition-selective pathways and whole-cell funcitons. Condition-selective marker genes of the indicated cell types or cell type groups were subjected to pathway enrichment analysis using the Molecular Biology of the Cell Ontology (MBCO). After expert curation of pathways and expressed pathway genes we grouped the pathways into 14 whole-cell functions. Note that the condition-selective pathway-whole cell function annotations for each cell type are the same as the subtype/state-selective annotations (Source Data).
